scope: Keep keyboard focus and accessible context inside Studio confirmation dialogs while actions are pending, including retry and opener removal.
implementation: ConfirmDialog now uses the existing Base UI modal primitive for portal rendering, focus trapping, background accessibility isolation, and normal focus restoration.
While busy, the dialog panel receives focus, exposes aria-busy and a Polish/English live status, and keeps confirm/cancel disabled.
Escape and outside dismissal are ignored while busy; when the operation fails and busy clears, retry/cancel are available again.
If the opener has been removed, focus returns to the main page region. Existing mobile bottom-sheet and desktop-centered visual placement are preserved.

checks.name: real-chromium-component-experiment
k34Cases: initial focus chooses safe Cancel; normal Tab and Shift+Tab wrap between controls
during busy, focus remains in alertdialog with no enabled buttons; background is aria-hidden and absent from the accessible role tree
aria-busy and translated live status are exposed while pending
Escape and Enter do not close or activate background/confirm while busy
after synthetic failure, retry becomes enabled; Escape closes and restores the opener
if the opener is removed, focus returns to the page main region

sourceEvidence: The browser bundle and original app/global styles are compiled from the current working tree; exact source hashes and observation details are recorded in ../ux-browser-experiment.json.
limits: This is an isolated React component harness with synthetic callbacks, not the full Next Studio or a real playlist DELETE request.
Chromium desktop only; no Safari, Firefox, screen reader, mobile hardware, or independent review. K34 remains partial.
handoff: Claude: verify the dialog in the full non-production Studio during a genuinely pending playlist delete, then test failure/retry, success, Escape policy, and removed opener with the supported browsers and at least one screen reader. Confirm the page background remains unavailable to keyboard and accessibility-tree navigation.
